title: Cross-Training
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for cross-training
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence from systematic reviews, clinical trials, and expert consensus supports the benefits of cross-training for fitness enhancement and injury prevention. Some evidence is emerging regarding optimal progression and modality blending. Ongoing research addresses long-term adherence and sport-specific adaptations.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
